doc.md:
Recognizes tablet stylus input.

The provided signals just relay the basic information of the
stylus events.

get_axes.brief: Returns the current values for the requested `axes`.
get_axes.md:
Returns the current values for the requested `axes`.

This function must be called from the handler of one of the
[`GestureStylus::down`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:down), [`GestureStylus::motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:motion),
[`GestureStylus::up`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:up) or [`GestureStylus::proximity`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:proximity)
signals.

get_axis.brief: Returns the current value for the requested `axis`.
get_axis.md:
Returns the current value for the requested `axis`.

This function must be called from the handler of one of the
[`GestureStylus::down`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:down), [`GestureStylus::motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:motion),
[`GestureStylus::up`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:up) or [`GestureStylus::proximity`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:proximity)
signals.

get_backlog.brief: Returns the accumulated backlog of tracking information.
get_backlog.md:
Returns the accumulated backlog of tracking information.

By default, GTK will limit rate of input events. On stylus input
where accuracy of strokes is paramount, this function returns the
accumulated coordinate/timing state before the emission of the
current [Gtk.GestureStylus::motion] signal.

This function may only be called within a [`GestureStylus::motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:motion)
signal handler, the state given in this signal and obtainable through
[`GestureStylus.get_axis()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#method:get_axis) express the latest (most up-to-date)
state in motion history.

The `backlog` is provided in chronological order.

get_device_tool.brief: Returns the `GdkDeviceTool` currently driving input through this gesture.
get_device_tool.md:
Returns the `GdkDeviceTool` currently driving input through this gesture.

This function must be called from the handler of one of the
[`GestureStylus::down`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:down), [`GestureStylus::motion`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:motion),
[`GestureStylus::up`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:up) or [`GestureStylus::proximity`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureStylus#event:proximity)
signals.

get_stylus_only.brief: Checks whether the gesture is for styluses only.
get_stylus_only.md:
Checks whether the gesture is for styluses only.

Stylus-only gestures will signal events exclusively from stylus
input devices.

set_stylus_only.md:
Sets the state of stylus-only

If true, the gesture will exclusively handle events from stylus input devices,
otherwise it'll handle events from any pointing device.

stylus-only.brief: If this gesture should exclusively react to stylus input devices.
stylus-only.md: If this gesture should exclusively react to stylus input devices.

down.brief: Emitted when the stylus touches the device.
down.md: Emitted when the stylus touches the device.

motion.brief: Emitted when the stylus moves while touching the device.
motion.md: Emitted when the stylus moves while touching the device.

proximity.brief: Emitted when the stylus is in proximity of the device.
proximity.md: Emitted when the stylus is in proximity of the device.

up.brief: Emitted when the stylus no longer touches the device.
up.md: Emitted when the stylus no longer touches the device.
